next.reason: 1985: "LABEL {RECORD IS|RECORDS ARE} {STANDARD|OMITTED} VALUE OF implementor-name-1 IS ... DATA {RECORD IS|RECORDS ARE}"; 2023: "FD file-name-1 [IS EXTERNAL..] [IS GLOBAL] [FORMAT..] [BLOCK CONTAINS..] [record-clause] [linage-clause] [CODE-SET..].". The 2023 sequential FD keeps BLOCK, RECORD, LINAGE and CODE-SET. It drops the LABEL RECORDS, VALUE OF and DATA RECORDS clauses, so programs using them are no longer accepted.
